data.body:
MERGED. Gerrit change 1202 landed on main as commit 338e397335 ("7f93: resolve a transition by
destination status"), with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

Closing with `--ref 338e397335` rather than moving this worktree's HEAD: three agents are working
concurrently and two share the main worktree, so pointing the completion verifier at the committed
tree of the fix itself is both safer and more precise than syncing HEAD and hoping it still
contains what the gate needs to see.

The AC-by-AC evidence is in the preceding comments. Restated so the close does not depend on
reading two of them:
  * a destination STATUS name now resolves to the transition that reaches it (`In Progress` ->
    `Start Progress`), asserted on the transition ID actually dispatched, not merely on "nothing
    raised";
  * an exact TRANSITION-name match still wins, so the change is additive and the existing live
    round-trip test passes unedited;
  * an AMBIGUOUS destination raises naming the competing routes rather than coin-flipping;
  * the unresolvable-name error now lists transitions AND their destinations, which is what makes
    the next occurrence self-explaining — the old message said `'In Progress'` was unavailable
    while the instance did offer a route to that status;
  * three mutation checks, each caught: name-only matching (3 failed), first-match-on-ambiguity
    (1 failed), destination-wins-over-exact-name (2 failed).

CLASS: preexisting. The defect was in the DC transport as shipped by story J6 and was neither
introduced nor regressed by the work that found it; it simply could not fire on Cloud, whose
workflow names transitions after their destinations.
